scientific_integrity: An integral filtered-chain proof is supplied; finite graph and integer-matrix computations serve as corroboration. Best-effort prior-work comparisons do not establish exhaustive novelty. Independent validation was not conducted.
scientific_limitations: Only clique-free simplicial complexes of two complete graphs sharing a clique of size at least two. Proves free integral homology, filtration-associated graded integral symmetry, and rational representation, not an integral equivariant splitting or homotopy classification. Arbitrary clique-sum trees and full graph automorphism group not analyzed.
title: Integral homology staircase and rational symmetry of two-clique sums
